name: Le Bandit

features.name: Golden squares
features.description: Winning positions turn golden; Super Cascades and coin symbols interact with golden squares to reveal values.

features.name: Rainbow symbols
features.description: Activate golden squares to reveal coins, clovers and pots.

review: Le Bandit is a more playful, lower-pressure Hacksaw game with a raccoon thief theme and a cluster-pays grid. Golden squares left behind by wins can be activated by rainbow symbols to reveal cash prizes or multipliers. Volatility is a step below Hacksaw's most extreme titles.
pros: A little less extreme than other Hacksaw hits
cons: Features can take a while to make sense
author: editorial-team
